context:
Goal: A session that builds or tests the shell reads the right screen widths.
Problem (rule): The shell sets its default side rail break at 1280px (app/src/App.css:23), and no record says so. The records you ruled (D95, shell rail and palette sheet; D276, palette go-to lists screens) give 1024 and 640. Only the code holds the 1280 now, and a record change needs your word.
Based on (read): banchi app/src/App.css:23 sets --bn-rail-break-px to 1280 (main 0657163). docs/DESIGN.md:587-588 puts the rail at 1024 and names 1280 only as 'the wide desk' step; no record names 1280 as the rail break.
Departs from: D95 says nothing about a 1280 rail break and the code uses it — D95 gets an AMENDED line that records 1280 as the default break.

options.gain: The records match the screen; a session reads one width.
options.how: Add an AMENDED line to D95 that names the 1280 default rail break.
options.label: Record 1280 in D95
options.lose: A width nobody ruled becomes a ruling.

options.gain: The shell follows the widths you ruled.
options.how: Rule 1280 a defect and change the code to the recorded widths.
options.label: Call 1280 wrong
options.lose: A code change on a screen, with a screen check, and a layout shift at 1024 to 1279.

ref: deep audit 1102, banchi homes; coordinator handoff/audit-child-questions 9d97c9b, oq-rail-break-1280
title: banchi: Record or reject the 1280px rail break?
